essence: Whether one underlying thing can remain despite apparent difference is questioned.
Causal difference is contrasted with ultimate difference: can different form still be one?
Whether action can be one agent when nature differs stands challenged.
Fruit production causes no harm, since action is not a separate power for us.
Power is the lord's own power, and the lord is the form of world-self.
